title: Advanced Fletching Table
description: Gives the fletching table real purpose. Craft arrows and spectral arrows, uncraft them back to materials, color your arrows with dye, remove colors or potion effects, and preserve trail colors through tipping. Supports wood variant arrows and dispensers.

● Advanced Fletching Table                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                               
  Gives the fletching table the purpose it always deserved. Craft, customize, and manage your arrows all in one place — with three dedicated tabs and full support for wood variant arrows.                                         
   
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  Features                                                        

  🪓 Craft Tab

  - Craft arrows from feather + stick + flint — more efficiently than a crafting table
  - Craft spectral arrows using glowstone (with or without flint)
  - Apply glowstone to an existing arrow to convert it into a spectral arrow — and if that arrow was colored, the spectral version keeps its color
  - Uncraft plain arrows back into feather, stick, and flint — no free materials, the ratio matches the craft output

  🌊 Untint Tab

  - Remove the trail color from a colored arrow using a water bucket
  - Remove the potion effect from a tipped arrow using a milk bucket (returns the original arrow type)
  - Remove the spectral effect from a spectral arrow using a water bucket (returns the original arrow type, even if it was a wood variant)

  🎨 Customize Tab

  - Apply a dye + glowstone to any arrow to give it a colored particle trail
  - Works in batches: X arrows + X dye + X glowstone = X colored arrows
  - Compatible with tipped arrows — keeps the potion effect

  ---
  Crafting Table Nerf

  Arrow crafting in the vanilla crafting table now produces only 1 arrow instead of 4. Use the fletching table to craft arrows efficiently. This is configurable.

  ---
  Compatibility

  - https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-cauldron — trail colors are preserved when tipping colored arrows in a brewing cauldron
  - Full support for MoreWeaponVariants wood variant arrows (oak, warped, bamboo, etc.)
  - Trail colors survive bows, crossbows, and dispensers
